overview: The handshake is the first packet on the connection and arrives before any anticheat pipeline exists, so no check in the corpus runs on it. The corpus hits are keyword noise from the proxy and Bungee search terms: chat-component imports, proxy registries and config flags. The only real processing is at the packet-library level, where Artemis decodes GPacketHandshakeClientSetProtocol in ArtemisDecoder.handleHandshake and routes the next-state field into the player profile, and Negativity intercepts PacketType.Handshake.IS_SET_PROTOCOL in its channel inbound handler. Both are infrastructure that establishes protocol state, not checks.
